title: A Trip to the Shop
text:
Ana goes to the shop on Saturday. She needs bread, milk and eggs. The shop is big and the prices are good. Ana pays with money from her wallet.

At the shop, Ana finds a red shirt. It costs ten dollars. She likes it, so she buys it. Then she goes home happy.

questions.text: What does Ana need to buy?
How much does the red shirt cost?
How does Ana feel about the shirt?
Why does Ana go home happy?

vocabulary.definition: a place where you buy things
a small flat case for money and cards
a piece of clothing for the top half of the body

paragraph_translations: Ana vai à loja no sábado. Ela precisa de pão, leite e ovos. A loja é grande e os preços são bons. Ana paga com dinheiro da sua carteira.
Na loja, Ana encontra uma camisa vermelha. Ela custa dez dólares. Ela gosta dela, então a compra. Depois ela volta para casa feliz.
